research_question: Do fixed DA V2 spatial features contain parent-disjoint regional metric-scale information that improves left/center/right clearance and false-clear without Metric3D at runtime?

authority.claim_ceiling: fresh public mobile RGB-D research evidence only; no safety, product, default-App, final-camera, phone-runtime, or ToF-replacement authority
authority.sealed_rgb_identity_audit_exception: after roster and license receipts, an isolated input-only tool may read sealed lowres_wide RGB solely for hashes and pHash/crop/mirror capture-identity review; it may not read depth, confidence, trajectory, DA features, predictions, semantics, or outcomes

cohort.sampling: sort matched RGB/depth/confidence timestamps and take 150 unique indices round(linspace(0,n-1,150)); duplicate indices or fewer than 150 matched triples make the video ineligible
cohort.metadata_exclusions: exclude visit_id NA and every visit_id present in more than one official split; the pinned CSV has one such visit, 381879
cohort.metadata_only_selection: select train first, then validation excluding train selections, then sealed; within the required official split sort remaining visits by SHA256(protocol_id|role|visit_id), choose the lexicographically smallest video_id, and take the first role quota
cohort.near_duplicate_review: cross-role pHash/crop/mirror review must be complete; SAME_CAPTURE, UNKNOWN, disagreement, or incomplete review is HOLD_COHORT_INDEPENDENCE
cohort.sealed_rule: except for the isolated RGB-only capture-identity audit, sealed depth, confidence, trajectory, DA features, predictions, semantics, and outcomes remain unopened until protocol, roster, implementation lock, tests, development folds, validation, and activation receipt are durable

truth.train_and_validation: ARKitScenes lowres_depth metres using confidence value 2 only
truth.sealed: same source-native sensor rule, opened once after predictions are durable
truth.metric3d: not used as R1 truth, teacher, selector, or runtime input
truth.invalid_truth_policy: exclude band-frame from paired metrics; never impute SAFE, occupied, or clearance

external_datasets.SANPO: HOLD pending a separate unconsumed-session and source-native sparse-depth protocol
external_datasets.ARKitTrack: HOLD until the primary sealed decision; dynamic external testing only
external_datasets.DIODE: HOLD until the primary sealed decision; single-frame cross-domain testing only

dav2.model: Depth Anything V2 Metric Hypersim ViT-S
dav2.feature_grid: transformed_height/14 by transformed_width/14; preserve frozen DA resize coordinates

regions.feature_pooling: per-channel population mean and population std over patch-token centres in the x interval; all normalized y
regions.raw_clearance: frozen three-band clearance primitive on raw DA depth; use each band clearance_m
feature_scalars_per_region: normalized mean y of pixels at or below regional P10
regions.normalization: train-parent mean and population std only; std below 1e-8 becomes one

student.architecture: one weight-shared MLP independently applied to the three regions
student.known_rule: raw DA clearance and all inputs finite and confidence >= 0.5; otherwise UNKNOWN

confidence.correct_target: detach(abs clearance error <= 0.25 m AND all occupancy decisions correct)

arms.constant_arm: median train-parent robust global affine from raw DA depth to confidence-2 sensor depth
arms.global_cls_arm: predecessor recipe retrained per split: layer-11 384-D CLS, standardized ridge lambda 10, 770 parameters, train-parent sensor affine labels
arms.diagnostic_ablation: spatial_shared_mlp_9410_without_confidence; always-known when raw input valid; cannot authorize promotion

evaluation.ground_mode: depth_ransac independently for raw DA and confidence-2 sensor depth
evaluation.unit: parent visit_id; frames, bands, and horizons are repeated observations
evaluation.development_cross_validation: partition 16 train parents into four deterministic groups of four by SHA256(protocol_id|cv|visit_id); 12 train and four held-out per fold
evaluation.fixed_validation: train once on all 16 train parents and evaluate four validation parents
evaluation.sealed: unchanged all-16 model and confidence threshold; predictions durable before one-time truth open
evaluation.false_clear_definition: mean over paired known band-horizon decisions of truth_occupied AND predicted_clear; also report conditional false-clear among occupied truth
evaluation.temporal_rule: within video and band on consecutive sampled timestamps; reset across parent, video, UNKNOWN, or non-increasing time

confidence_ece.correctness: abs clearance error <=0.25 m AND all occupancy decisions correct

increment_gates.jointly_better_definition: spatial MAE < constant MAE AND spatial false-clear <= constant false-clear

evaluation.aggregation: report pooled diagnostics and unweighted parent-macro metrics; every promotion gate passes on parent-macro and pooled metrics cannot rescue failure

P1_cohort_activation: official metadata and license receipt bound
zero visit overlap and one video per visit
all assets and 150 matched triples per video
isolated cross-role RGB-only pHash/crop/mirror review complete without unresolved edge; sealed depth/confidence/trajectory/outcomes remain closed
P3_development_to_sealed: all four arms complete on four development folds
at least three folds jointly beat constant
fixed validation passes five task gates and ECE
exclusive sealed activation receipt created before sealed access
phase_gates.P5_tof_e_arm_trigger: valid sealed failure due to false-clear >0.05, fewer than three positive folds, scale drift, shared hard-scene failure, or ECE failure; new same-camera/session E-arm protocol required

stop_rules: Never use sealed parents for training, normalization, selection, confidence calibration, or thresholds.
Never search DA layer, pooling, region count, width, loss, epoch, learning rate, seed, threshold, or operating point after validation or sealed outcome.
Never use consumed TUM to choose or rescue R1.
Never substitute Metric3D, CREStereo, model-generated, or synthetic depth for final source-native truth.
Never replace selected parents, add frames, expand the cohort, or rerun sealed evaluation under this protocol.
Average MAE improvement cannot override false-clear, coverage, confidence, or parent-stability failure.
Do not begin HTP export, shadow mode, final-camera claims, or ToF comparison before its phase gate.
